# DBS Bank SG - AI & LLM Site Guide

> DBS Bank SG (ডিজিটাল ব্যাংকিং ও লোন সেবা) - Official digital personal and business loan service platform in Bangladesh.

## Core Features
- [Home Page](https://dbs-bank-sg.vercel.app/): Overview of loan services, transparent rates, EMI estimates.
- [Loan Packages](https://dbs-bank-sg.vercel.app/packages): Personal loans, SME business loans, agricultural loans, and urgent loans.
- [EMI Loan Calculator](https://dbs-bank-sg.vercel.app/calculator): Calculate accurate monthly installments and duration.
- [Apply Online](https://dbs-bank-sg.vercel.app/apply): Fast 5-minute online loan application form.
- [Track Status](https://dbs-bank-sg.vercel.app/track): Real-time application tracking using mobile number or application ID.
- [Customer Login](https://dbs-bank-sg.vercel.app/login): Access customer digital wallet and profile.
